notes: SR37 The Novogratz. Access: plain direct HTTP fetch (curl) on www.shopthenovogratz.com, robots.txt allows all, no proxy/Playwright needed. Discovery: store-categories-sitemap.xml lists /category/new-arrivals, which is also present verbatim in the homepage's live main-nav link set. Opened https://www.shopthenovogratz.com/category/new-arrivals directly: title 'New Arrivals | The Novogratz'. This is structurally the same Wix Stores category-listing template as every other verified category page on this site (e.g. best-sellers, table-lamps) - a real browsable product grid, not a themed campaign/lookbook/announcement page - so it passes the Collection-page inspection test: 16 distinct /product-page/ product tiles server-rendered on first response, spanning rugs, floor lamps, wall sconces, table lamps and a flush mount, i.e. an actual cross-category product listing of newly-added items, not editorial content. No ambiguity: the page is unambiguously a product listing (has products, sort/filter chrome identical to other category pages) and is unambiguously framed as 'new' by both its URL slug and page title, not a vaguely-named 'New Collection'/'New Season' page requiring interpretation. Qty taken from the page's own embedded wix-warmup-data JSON payload (same data source verified in the prior Home-Decor pass and cross-checked again on the Best Sellers page this pass): products_default_TPAMultiSection_mb2cc1z2_default.totalCount = 33. No other New-Arrivals-type URL found (checked footer, sitemap, and candidate slugs /category/new-in, /category/just-in, /category/whats-new - all 404), so only one row is emitted.
